description: telemetry-stream-open.v1: the first event of an application telemetry stream (spec 030). `position` is where the stream starts: the position the client resumed from, or the organization's current head for a fresh stream (`0` when it has no retained events). `devices` is the size of the resolved device set the stream carries. Producer: the runtime, relayed once per client stream by Laravel. Consumer: applications and the integration SDK.
